kaede.title: Two Stolen Bottles
kaede.text: Kaede hauls you up the ladder to the roof of the house with two bottles of wine she very obviously did not pay for, the glass still cold and sweating from the cellar. The tiles hold the day's warmth, chimney smoke drifts past the stars, and her copper tail thumps the roof behind her. "Back in my party, nobody ever had my back. Then this skinny guy in a hoodie jumps in front of a goblin for me." She bumps your shoulder with hers. "Idiot." She doesn't move away, and her tail curls lightly around your ankle.
ngpp: Halfway through popping the cork, she pauses squinting at the bottle label as though it tastes like another rooftop altogether.
"Weird question, Sam—have we ever sat up here drinking cheaper vintage than this? Felt like my tail found your boot on muscle memory."
She doesn't even pretend it's casual this time, hooking her tail squarely behind your ankle. "Don't ask me how I knew you like sitting by the east chimney, Sam. Just pour."

choices.label: Stay on the roof with her
choices.res: You find the bottle in your hand somehow empty and the stars somehow lower. Kaede's tail never unwinds from your ankle, and neither of you points it out.

choices.label: Pass the conversation back to her wine
choices.res: {N} snorts into the bottle and lets you off the hook. Her tail still sneaks one lazy swish against your leg as you climb down.

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop at night bumping shoulders with him, holding a wine bottle, fox tail swishing
image.setting: tiled rooftop over a fantasy town at night, stars, chimney smoke

kaede.title: Wrong Door
kaede.text: You shoulder open the washroom door and find Kaede mid-towel, steam curling off her sun-kissed skin, the thin scar on her shoulder pink from the heat. Every single hair on her tail stands straight up like a startled bottlebrush. For one long second the only sound is a dripping tap and your brain emptying itself of all vocabulary.

1.title: Share the Steam
1.text: You push open the washroom door to find Kaede perched on the edge of the steaming tub with her wet hair plastered over one collarbone and a towel barely tucked around her thighs. Her fox ears perk upright before softening into a bold, crimson-cheeked grin. "Forgot how to knock again, Sam—or did you come in here to earn those bruises on your hands?"

choices.label: Offer to scrub the knot out of her scarred shoulder
choices.res: Kaede lets the towel slip to her waist with a shaky breath as your warm, soapy palms knead down her bare shoulder blades—until she spins around in the mist, grabs your collar, and pulls your mouth straight onto hers.
choices.fallbackRes: Her fox tail thumps against the wet wood as your warm palms work along her shoulders until she leans back shivering softly against your chest.

choices.label: Hand her a fresh towel and give her space
choices.res: "Gentleman tonight, huh?" She smirks as she catches the linen, tail curling warmly around your wrist for one lingering second.

3.title: No Towel Needed
3.text: Steam rolls thick through the washroom when you step inside—and Kaede doesn't bother grabbing for the towel draped over the stool. Sitting waist-deep in the hot tub with water glistening over bare breasts and copper skin flushed bright pink, she hooks one damp ankle straight behind your calf. "Lock the bolt, Sam. Unless you came in here just to stare?"

choices.label: Lock the door and get into the tub with her
choices.res: You kick your boots off fast and slide into the steaming water across from her—before Kaede climbs straight over your lap with a fierce, wicked grin, sinking down onto your cock until hot bathwater sloshes clean over the rim.

choices.label: Tease her and wash her back first
choices.res: You kneel beside the tub rubbing warm lather across her shoulders and breasts until she groans, twists around, and drags your wet shirt straight toward the water.

choices.label: Apologize and bolt
choices.res: Kaede laughs about it for ten straight minutes. Through the door. Loudly enough that the whole corridor learns what happened, and at dinner she toasts you with a spoon.

choices.label: Compliment her
choices.res: She grins, tail slowly settling, and doesn't bother holding the towel very hard. "Smooth, Sam. Real smooth." The warmth in her voice outlasts the steam.

else.res: "GET OUT." The towel hits you square in the face, still warm and smelling of her soap, and the door slams hard enough to rattle the hinges.

choices.label: Stand there like an idiot
choices.res: "Take a picture, it lasts longer." You have no idea how she knows that phrase, but she is smirking when she says it, tail fluffed with pride rather than panic.

image.comp: frozen mid-towel in a washroom doorway, every hair on her fox tail standing straight up, wide-eyed

kaede.title: Tail Says Otherwise
kaede.text: Kaede turns up at your door with a bandaged hand and a bright grin, claiming she got hurt sparring "for fun." The knuckles under the linen are split and puffy, and she smells of liniment and sawdust. She sits on the edge of your bed while you unwind and re-wrap it with clumsy care, and her tail keeps brushing your arm, back and forth, warm and soft. Neither of you mentions it.

choices.label: Finish the bandage and pull her close
choices.res: The moment you tie off the linen, Kaede catches your collar with her good hand and tumbles back across the mattress, pulling you down with her tail tight around your waist.

choices.label: Finish the bandage slowly
choices.res: You take your time over the knot, and she lets you, eyes on your hands instead of the wall. Her tail stops pretending it's accidental.

choices.label: Tie it off and tease her about sparring
choices.res: "For fun," you repeat, deadpan. {N} flicks your ear for it, but her laugh is soft and she stays seated a minute longer than she needs to.

image.comp: sitting on a kitchen table while he bandages her hand, grinning, fox tail brushing his arm
image.setting: inn kitchen at night, a first-aid kit

kaede.title: The Old Party
kaede.text: Kaede's old party leader turns up at the bar in dungeon-stained leathers, trailing the smell of rain and old smoke. He has a new contract, a deep dungeon and a spot for her, if she wants it. The common room goes quiet. Kaede doesn't look at him; she looks at you, ears pinned flat, and waits with her fingers drumming on the counter.
ngpp: When the scarred adventurer steps up to the bar, Kaede flashes an odd, almost impatient look—like she has already told this man no in another life.
"Why does it feel like he always walks in wearing the same muddy boots?" Kaede mutters sideways to you, ears pinned tight while waiting on your word.
Kaede doesn't even wait for the captain to finish his pitch before sliding closer to your elbow. "Same answer as always, Sam. Just say the word."

choices.label: "Go, if it's what you want."
choices.res: She stays. Later she grumbles into her cup: "You weren't supposed to make it easy." But she sits close all night.

choices.label: "Stay. Please."
choices.res: Kaede turns the leader down without even looking at him, and the ex-captain leaves with his ears burning. Her tail slaps your leg twice under the bar, hard, happy.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.res: She leaves for two days without a word. When she comes back, she doesn't mention it. Neither do you. It sits between you for a while, like a bill nobody wants to read.

image.comp: standing at a bar between him and a rugged adventurer in armor, arms crossed, looking at him and waiting
image.setting: busy tavern bar, adventurers at tables

kaede.title: Rooftops
kaede.text: Kaede teaches you to run the rooftops of Hollowmere at night, hopping slate to slate in the moonlight as though gravity were a polite suggestion. You, in your grey hoodie and traveler's cloak, are very, very bad at it. You windmill across a gap, cling to a chimney, and apologize to a pigeon. Kaede crouches on the ridgeline above, hands on her knees, wheezing with laughter.

2.text: Kaede drags you across Hollowmere's moonlit slate roofs again, though instead of leaving you stranded by a chimney she hops cleanly back into your reach whenever you wobble, fox tail brushing warmly behind your waist. Perched together beside a sun-warmed dormer overlooking twin moons, she grins brightly with flushed cheeks—clearly looking for any excuse to catch you.

choices.label: Keep trying
choices.res: By the end of the night you make one jump cleanly. She cheers loud enough to wake the whole street, and a shutter bangs open below you both. Neither of you cares.

choices.label: Fake a sprained ankle so she carries you
choices.res: She sees right through it, ears twitching with delight. She carries you anyway, the whole way home, over her shoulder and grumbling that you weigh nothing.

choices.label: Duck through the attic skylight together into the empty loft
choices.res: Kaede drops cleanly down through the skylight onto piled spare blankets, grinning wide as she tugs your collar straight after her.

image.comp: leaping across rooftops at night, laughing back at the man clinging to a chimney
image.setting: moonlit rooftops of a fantasy town

kaede.title: Copper Fox, Kept
kaede.text: After closing, Kaede corners you in the kitchen, where the stove is still ticking as it cools and one lamp burns low. She drums her fingers on the table, stops, starts again. "I'm bad at this, so I'll just say it. I'm not going anywhere. Not for the money. For you." Her ears are bright red to the tips and her tail won't stop wagging. She takes your hand and pulls you upstairs, shutting the bedroom door cleanly behind you both.
ngpp: Even as she pulls you toward the stairs, she laughs breathlessly—like she's waited through more than one quiet kitchen to finally lock this door.
"Don't laugh, Sam, I swear I've stood by this exact stove blushing my tail off before," she murmurs, fingers squeezing yours tight.
"Forget whatever got scrubbed off the calendar, Sam," Kaede whispers fierce and bright against your throat. "Every cycle ends with me backing you into this room."
kaede.goLead: Kaede pushes the bedroom door shut with her heel and wraps both arms straight around your neck, her copper tail tangling behind your thighs as she kisses you fiercely.

choices.label: Say yes
Not yet
choices.res: {N} nods too fast. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." Her tail droops, then perks up again, stubborn.
